inlines.v: AREOT'IC, adjective [Gr. thin.] Attenuating; making thin, as in liquids; rarefying. AREOT'IC, noun A medicine, which attenuates the humors, dissolves viscidity, opens the pores, and increases perspiration; an attenuant.
